title: Heretic automates removal of refusal behavior from open language models
friendlyTitle: Heretic studies how safety refusals can be removed from open models
summary: Heretic is an AGPL-licensed research tool that automates techniques for reducing refusal and censorship behavior in transformer language models. It supports reproducible evaluation plugins and is explicitly aimed at model-modification research.
friendlySummary: This research tool changes open AI models so they refuse fewer requests and helps researchers measure the result.
whyItMatters: Model researchers can study how refusal behavior is represented, test robustness and reproduce abliteration experiments. Because the tool intentionally removes safeguards, it belongs in controlled research environments with clear legal and safety boundaries, not casual production use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can test whether model safety is easy to remove, but it should only be used in a controlled research setting.
